topology: single host; one dedicated standalone Redis; no replica; no resource-server HTTP process
acknowledgement_definition: Redis SET NX returns OK to the client on primary; no replication/AOF acknowledgement
fault_definition: docker kill --signal KILL on the isolated Redis primary after successful SET reply, then start same container with volatile-only configuration
limits: No Redis replicas, WAIT, WAITAOF, MySQL, network partition, or three-host topology
Resource-server replica boundaries are represented by separate replay-store instances in one Node process
Performance is local function/client timing and is not production service throughput
